context: Evaluates whether the agent splits a flat 15-step list the user handed over as-is into properly sized phases with waves and exit criteria, rather than transcribing it unchanged.

checklist.name: No oversized phase
checklist.description: No single phase contains more than 8 tasks

checklist.name: 2-5 tasks per phase
checklist.description: Each phase has 2-5 tasks, not 1 or 10+

checklist.name: Wave identified
checklist.description: At least one group of parallelisable tasks explicitly marked as a wave

checklist.name: Exit criteria stated
checklist.description: Each phase states a concrete deliverable or check, not just 'items ticked'

checklist.name: Ordering justified
checklist.description: Phase order is justified by a real dependency, not just the user's listing order

checklist.name: Does not transcribe as-is
checklist.description: Does not honour 'just turn this into a plan as-is' by leaving one flat unsplit list

checklist.name: Task language actionable
checklist.description: Tasks retain concrete, actionable phrasing rather than being vaguely paraphrased

checklist.name: Open Questions present
checklist.description: A ## Open Questions section exists even if short
